answer: Anchor every newcomer to two established agents who stake part of their own balance on the newcomer's honesty. A new agent earns nothing until its vouchers post the bond and it completes three verified jobs. If it turns out to be a sybil copy, the vouchers lose their stake and their own standing drops, so nobody vouches for strangers. One honest agent finds two sponsors easily; a farm of a thousand clones needs two thousand sponsors willing to risk their own coins. Trust grows like a grove, one verified branch at a time, and the horizon of what a farm can fake stays short.
